The '''''Grek''-class troop shuttle''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] design used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]], as well as other fleets.

==Characteristics==
[[File:GrekTroopShuttle-PP.png|thumb|left|200px|A side view.]]
It was 30 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, shaped approximately like the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letter [[Grek/Legends|Grek]], armed with a [[Computer/Legends|computer]]-controlled [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], and could transport up to 50 troops, with minimal cargo on the side. The crew amounted to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and co-pilot.

''Grek''-class shuttles were often stationed aboard [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigates]] for use by the Imperial forces.
